name: Severe Weather Forecast Signal
description: One forecast-basis firing of the FROZEN severe-weather detector run over the Open-Meteo forecast feed (warnings_engine/forecast.py), or a missed_event accounting row. ADMIN/TELEMETRY ONLY - never sent to clients, never creates or alters a Severe Weather Warning, never mixed with observed-basis statistics. Every open signal is later settled against observed data (hit / false_alarm) by the daily verification pass; no forecast accuracy is claimed until this ledger accumulates. All datetimes are UTC.

fields.label: Basis
fields.description: Always "forecast" - the hard tag separating these rows from observed-basis warnings. Forecast-basis and observed-basis signals never mix in any statistic.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: open = fired, awaiting observed data; hit = extremes materialized in the predicted window (verified at the outcome ledger's own thresholds); false_alarm = the window elapsed quietly; missed_event = an observed-basis warning-tier episode no forecast signal preceded

fields.label: Observed Episode
fields.description: Only on missed_event rows: the observed-basis episode the forecast pass failed to precede

fields.label: Issued At (UTC)
fields.description: When the pass first fired this signal (missed_event rows: when the miss was recorded)

fields.label: Refreshed At (UTC)
fields.description: Last hourly pass that still showed the event. A fired signal is never deleted by a weakening forecast - it stays until observed data settles it.

fields.label: First Forecast Hour (UTC)
fields.description: First future hour at which the frozen conditions reach warning tier on the forecast timeline (latest refresh's view)

fields.label: Lead (h)
fields.description: Hours between issue and the first forecast warning-tier hour

fields.label: Horizon (h)
fields.description: Configured forward horizon at issue time

fields.label: Peak Tier
fields.description: Highest detector tier over the forecast window - high-water mark across refreshes

fields.label: Peak Confidence
fields.description: Highest gated detector score over the forecast window - high-water mark across refreshes

fields.label: Forecast Model
fields.description: Open-Meteo model the series came from (best_match unless severe_weather_forecast_model is set)

fields.label: Frozen Config SHA256
fields.description: sha256 of the frozen detector config the firing used - provenance proof that no threshold differed from the observed-basis detector

fields.label: Evidence (admin only)
fields.description: JSON schema v1: {version, basis, issued_at, first_forecast_at, lead_hours, horizon_hours, peak_tier, peak_confidence, already_active_at_issue, fired_conditions, source, model, config_sha256} (missed_event rows carry {kind, warning, onset, cover_tolerance_hours}). Never sent to clients.

fields.label: Verification (admin only)
fields.description: JSON written when the daily pass settles the signal against observed data: {window, observed peaks, verdict, observed_source, data_horizon, verified_at}
